title: Guard against dependabot lockfile workspace-entry drift for optional deps
description: On 2026-09-29 dependabot rebases of optional provider SDK bumps (#587 codex-sdk, #586 MCP SDK, #584 claude-agent-sdk) each injected a spurious entry into package-lock.json packages/core 'dependencies' while package.json lists those packages only under optionalDependencies. CI (npm ci, install smokes, artifact builds) stayed green, so nothing caught it; #592 happened to normalize it. Consider a CI check that 'npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts' leaves package-lock.json unchanged, or a docs/dependencies.md review rule. Evidence: eshyra-7p3k notes.
